description: This file declares internal API functions for the Http Ato FxCat2 component, including creation of code and name tables, and retrieval of atom codes and names.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat2CreateCodeTable
methods.description: Creates a code table for the Http Ato FxCat2 component.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat2CreateNameTable
methods.description: Creates a name table for the Http Ato FxCat2 component.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat2GetAtomCode
methods.description: Retrieves the atom code associated with a given name.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat2GetAtomName
methods.description: Retrieves the atom name associated with a given code.
